plain_english: One ActionBroker emits the legal handles consumed by both standard policy and bounded exploration.
In this narrow frozen test fixture, the expansion function explicitly scores Sol Ring higher, so the exploratory selection is fixture-driven rather than evidence of general strategic insight.
The first differing handles are recorded in a DivergenceMeasurement, and a second broker refresh revokes the previous generation’s handle.
title: Standard and exploratory paths share one broker action set and record a fixture-driven first divergence
